spec.label: Repair task

spec.query: query_result(scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", cron!="ad-hoc"} or (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", cron="ad-hoc"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_run_start_seconds{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} >= time() - $__range_s)))

spec.definition: query_result(scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", cron!="ad-hoc"} or (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", cron="ad-hoc"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_run_start_seconds{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} >= time() - $__range_s)))

spec.title: Repair tasks
spec.description: Name, Type and Cron are the task's current configuration. The remaining properties are the ones the most recent run started with, so they stay unchanged until the task runs again and are empty until it runs for the first time after Scylla Manager restarts.

spec.expr: max by (task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}))

(max by (task) ((time() - scylla_manager_scheduler_last_success{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair"}) and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}))) or (max by (task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}) * 0 + 99999999)

max by (task) ((scylla_manager_repair_progress{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} or avg by (cluster, task) (scylla_manager_tablet_repair_progress{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"})) and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}))
max by (task, name, cron, type) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"})

max by (task, keyspace, dc, keyspace_replication, incremental_mode, host, fail_fast, ignore_down_hosts) (scylla_manager_repair_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}))

(max by (task) ((scylla_manager_repair_progress{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"} or avg by (cluster, task) (scylla_manager_tablet_repair_progress{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster"})) and on(task) (scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair"} == 1)) or max by (task) ((scylla_manager_scheduler_task_state{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair"} != 1) - 10)) * on(task) group_left(name) (topk(1, scylla_manager_scheduler_task_properties{exported_cluster=~"$sm_cluster", cluster="$cluster", type=~"repair|tablet_repair", name=~"$repair_task"}) by (task))
